description: One-call health overview across every check: which are DOWN (since when, error), which have an invalid SSL certificate, which certificates or domains expire within N days, and which checks are paused or muted. Built from GET /api/checks.

domain_days.description: Flag domains expiring within this many days (default 30).

ssl_days.description: Flag SSL certificates expiring within this many days (default 14).

name: updown_find_problems
title: Find checks with problems
